request.name: Capture a URL screenshot or PDF

description.content: Capture a public or authorized URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. This endpoint returns binary image/PDF data directly.

query.description: (Required) Absolute http or https URL to capture. Public or authorized URLs only.
Viewport width in pixels. Maximum 1920.
Viewport height in pixels. Maximum 10000.
Capture the full scrollable page.
Output format.
JPEG/WebP quality from 1 to 100.
Force light or dark color-scheme rendering.
Navigation lifecycle event to wait for before capture.
CSS selector to wait for before capture.
Additional delay in milliseconds after the page loads.
Block common ad and tracker requests during capture.
Hide and accept common cookie banners before capture.
CSS to inject before capture. Maximum 10000 characters.
JavaScript to evaluate before capture. Maximum 10000 characters.
Use stealth rendering for authorized targets.
Retina/HiDPI capture scale.
IANA timezone to emulate, such as America/New_York.
BCP 47 locale to emulate, such as en-US.
Response cache TTL in seconds. Maximum 604800.
Preload discovered Google Fonts before capture.
Comma-separated CSS selectors to remove before capture.
Remove common popups, modals, and overlays.
Wrap the screenshot in a device frame.
Latitude for browser geolocation override.
Longitude for browser geolocation override.
Geolocation accuracy in meters.
